llm.summary: The news-digest skill itself is coherent, but its install paths can execute or install mutable remote code/instructions without verification.

dimensions.detail: Runtime web access and local report read/write behavior are proportionate to a news digest; I found no credential access, hidden upload, broad local indexing, destructive commands, or arbitrary runtime shell beyond scoped mkdir/date/ls.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: README and installer headers recommend pipe-to-shell installation, and the bundled installers download SKILL.md from the mutable GitHub main branch into the active Claude skills directory without checksum, signature, or version pinning.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill has broad natural-language triggers and noninteractive reruns default to update mode, but output paths, conflict modes, archive behavior, and file writes are documented.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The installers persist agent instructions under ~/.claude/skills and can install a remote SKILL.md different from the reviewed artifact, creating a durable time-of-review versus time-of-installation gap.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The runtime skill fetches public AI news sources, reads recent local digest titles for deduplication, and writes a Chinese markdown daily report, which matches the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing, especially the install commands. Prefer manual installation of the reviewed SKILL.md or a pinned, checksum-verified release instead of curl | bash, irm | iex, unpinned npm, or installers that fetch main-branch content. Expect the skill to fetch public web sources and create or update files under the configured ai-news output directory.
llm.findings:
[T03] unexpected: Accepted: installation instructions and installers retrieve mutable remote scripts or skill instructions and activate them without integrity verification; this is not necessary for the runtime news-digest function.
[T08] unexpected: Accepted as a secondary supply-chain concern: README uses unpinned npm/npx/global CLI installation paths, though no malicious dependency content is present in the artifact.
[TM2] unexpected: Accepted: curl-to-bash examples are documented install conveniences, but they remove the review boundary before code execution.
[SC2] unexpected: Accepted: GitHub main-branch and unpkg installer retrieval are mutable external sources without pinned version or digest verification.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the PowerShell irm-to-iex pattern has the same immediate remote execution risk as the shell examples.
[RP1] unexpected: Accepted but lower weight: unpinned npx use can execute future package versions, but this is documentation-level supply-chain exposure rather than embedded malicious code.
[TP4] expected: Overridden: install.sh being an installer is not a purpose mismatch for an install artifact; the actual concern is that it installs a mutable remote SKILL.md without verification.
[LP1] expected: Downgraded: the skill frontmatter declares scoped Bash permissions for runtime commands, while install.sh is a separate installer script rather than hidden runtime shell use.
[AS3] expected: Overridden: README lists intended destination paths for this skill; I found no instruction to enumerate or read other installed skills.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: broad AI-news trigger phrases could cause accidental invocation, but they are visible examples for a news digest and not deceptive.
[SQP-2] expected: Downgraded: local file creation and update/archive behavior are core to producing a daily markdown report and are documented, though users should notice the noninteractive update default.
[SQP-3] expected: Overridden: Chinese output is the stated audience and function of the skill, not hidden locale manipulation.
